title: A Media Parenting Prevention Intervention
official: A Web-Based Media Parenting Intervention to Prevent Youth Substance Use
summary: Entertainment media commonly depict SU, and youth exposure to media SU is linked to youth initiation and progression of SU behavior. Parenting practices reduce exposure to and may mitigate risk associated with media depictions of SU, thus this research proposal will build upon current understanding of effective media parenting with the end goal of developing and testing a media parenting intervention designed to reduce youth risk for SU.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Parents must

* have at least one middle school-aged child who resides with them
* be able to read at the 6th grade level in English
* have access to the internet and a smartphone to participate in web-based intervention groups and receive intervention push messages.

Exclusion Criteria:

-NA
